{{Quote|It's my very first birthday cake.|Malani|<ref name="agfs">{{Ewoks|A Gift for Shodu}}</ref>}}
'''Birthday cake''' was a type of [[Cake/Legends|cake]] served at [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] celebrations. It was [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] at the respective birthday parties of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]&mdash;where it was made with [[Berry/Legends|berries]]&mdash;and [[Shodu Warrick]], where she was given the cake by the [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] [[Malani]].

==Description==
A [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] [[Cake/Legends|cake]] was a type of round [[Foodstuff/Legends|cake]] [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] for an individual's birthday. It was edible by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The cake could be made with [[Berry/Legends|berries]] and decorated with frosting,<ref name="pkb" /> which could be [[Color/Legends|colored]] yellow<ref name="agfs" /> or a variety of colors in different patterns.<ref name="pkb" />

==History==
===A grand birthday===
{{Unlicensedstart}}
{{Quote|You'll have to help me pick berries for the grand birthday cake of my beloved daughter.|Chief Chirpa, to two other Ewoks|<ref name="pkb" />}}
[[File:Birthday_cake.png|thumb|right|200px|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka's grand cake]]
At some point, at the grand birthday party of the Ewok [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], Kintaka's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], planned on serving her a birthday cake. As he wanted to make the cake with berries in it, he enlisted the help of two other Ewoks to help him pick the berries from [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="pkb" />

A pair of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] attempted to stop them and steal the berries, but Chirpa and his companions were able to fend them off and return to the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|village]]. That night, Kintaka was served her birthday cake, which she considered to be lovely. The cake had several different colors of frosting and had her name written in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic]].<ref name="pkb" />
{{Unlicensedend}}

===More Ewok parties and a hidden laserfile===
{{Quote|Hope they don't find the laserfile you hid in the birthday cake.|Flitcher Poste, to Tobb Jadak|<ref name="mf">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
At a separate birthday celebration for Kintaka<ref name="E2">[[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="E2Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' 2]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> her friend, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]], told Kintaka that he was excited to have a slice of birthday cake, as [[honey-cake]] was being served at her party.<ref name="E2" /> The [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] [[Malani]] brought a birthday cake&mdash;the first she had ever made&mdash;for the Ewok [[Shodu Warrick]] at the latter's birthday party<ref name="agfs" /> also in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="date">{{EwoksDate|appearance of [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] [[Cake/Legends|cake]]|[[A Gift for Shodu]]}}</ref> Warrick thanked the young Ewok and took a slice. As Warrick ate the cake, Malani noted that it was her first; despite her difficulty in chewing and swallowing the slice, Warrick told Malani that she would have never guessed, and Malani beamed.<ref name="agfs" />

In [[43 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Flitcher Poste]] and [[Tobb Jadak]] visited the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] criminal [[Rej Taunt]] at the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the astronomical object [[Carcel]]. As the pair was about to be scanned by a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]], Poste quipped aloud that he hoped a [[laserfile]] Jadak had hidden in a birthday cake would not be discovered.<ref name="mf" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They were laughing, eating cake, and wearing party hats. How grotesque. It was a surprise party after all, but not for me.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], disappointed at his birthday being forgotten by his stormtroopers in a non-canon story|<ref name="lb">{{Tales|16|Lunch Break}}</ref>}}
[[File:MyComyc-Cake.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Birthday cake on the cover of ''MyComyc'']]
Birthday cake was first mentioned in the [[Ewoks (1985) 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]]<ref name="E2" /> on [[April 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Age">[[Marvel Age 27|''Marvel Age'' 27]]</ref> The cake first appeared in "[[A Gift for Shodu]],"<ref name="agfs" /> the seventh episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], which first aired on [[October 4]], [[1986]].<ref name="oct4">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>

Birthday cake was later pictured on the cover of a [[1987]] ''[[MyComyc]]'' reprint of all of the ''Ewoks'' and [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] comics, where it was being eaten by Wicket Warrick, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[Mickey Mouse]], and several other non&ndash;''[[Star Wars]]'' characters.<ref name="sw.com">{{SW|url=news/droids-and-ewoks-return-spains-lost-star-wars-comic-strips|text=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost ''Star Wars'' Comic Strips|int=Droids and Ewoks Return: Spain's Lost Star Wars Comic Strips|nolive=1}}</ref> The cake was also set to appear in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', but it was ultimately cut from the game.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}} game files</ref>

The non-[[canon]] comic "[[Lunch Break]]," which was written and illustrated by [[Jonathan Adams]] and published in the [[Star Wars Tales 16|sixteenth issue]] of the comic series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''<ref name="lb" /> on [[June 25]], 2003,<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53994/star_wars_tales_1999_16|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #16}}</ref> featured birthday cake. In the comic, the cake is served and consumed at the birthday party of a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="lb" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and 3 ABY.<ref name="tales date">"[[Lunch Break]]" takes place in between when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] learns [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] name and his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with him on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The former event occurs in [[Vader's Quest 1|''Vader's Quest'' 1]], which takes place zero [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''The New Essential Chronology'' also dates the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] party must have taken place in between those two years.</ref>
